text:
The temptation in this kind of tool is to let the data flatter the result. TextOS draws the line in its own product history: demand decides what is measured, never the result. Among the shortcuts the code refuses, TextOS lists attaching a search volume to the single question being measured. That matters because one question only stands in for many ways of asking the same thing, so a monthly figure pinned on it would overstate what it represents.

The same rule closes the manual route. In TextOS, demand strength can no longer be typed in by an operator. Instead, TextOS derives demand strength from evidence, or leaves it absent. A blank is less pleasant to read than a confident label, but it tells you something true about what is known.
